label: main season
summary: Recommend clearance for sign-off. E1 is an unchecked database report of a past accident inside the area, which the national criteria make a clearance target after the first visit. E2 is a first-hand informant’s located report of an explosion-related animal death, also a target. Technical survey is not available under the programme; cancellation is not supported.
flags: E1 has no date or other detail, and its location has not been checked on the ground.
The informant for E2 says he can show the team the reported location.

checks.detail: Every item of the evidence log is in the register.
The national criteria provide no technical survey, so clearance takes its place; evidence to target: E1, E2.

E1.quote: The national mine action database records one or more past landmine accidents inside this area.
E1.note: This is an unverified database record with no date or ground-checked location, so it suggests EO may be present but is not confirmation; its reliability is class 6.

E2.quote: A man who hunts and fishes said a horse was killed by an explosion at the edge of the pasture about 6 years ago; he saw the place the next day and can show it to the team.
E2.note: A first-hand informant reports the aftermath and can identify the location, but no EO was directly observed or confirmed; this is target indirect evidence from a class 4 source.
